baseline_models.mechanism: A still-owned social body deliberately makes alternatives into objects of worship. The focus does not merely list erroneous beliefs; it assigns a collective act of adoption to 'our people.'

activation_trace.role: The human-group image identifies the collective agent while preserving the speakers' relation to it.
Making or acquiring something for oneself turns worship into deliberate adoption.
Otherness or being besides positions the adopted objects as alternatives to Him.
The worship and worshipped-object image identifies what the group installs and keeps the model cultically anchored.

changed_reading.after: The ayah indicts communal institution-making: 'our people' have appropriated alternatives and installed them as objects of worship.

baseline_models.mechanism: The claimants bear a production burden. Their adopted gods require a warrant that can be brought forward, that overpowers counterclaim, and that emerges into clarity.

activation_trace.role: Bringing or presenting makes the demanded warrant something the claimants must produce.
The overpowering-proof image sets a warrant strong enough to defeat the deity-claim's countercase.
Emergence and disclosure make clarity a manifest property of the required warrant.

changed_reading.before: They have no proof for their gods.
changed_reading.after: The challenge is procedural: produce a presentable, reality-disclosing warrant with decisive force; inherited assertion has no evidentiary standing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا
baseline_models.mechanism: False attribution is both manufacture and wrong: an invented claim is assigned to God and thereby withholds the truthful attribution due to Him.

activation_trace.role: Withholding or blocking a right frames false attribution as denial of what is due.
The invented-lie image supplies deliberate manufacture rather than accidental error.
Contrariety to truth classifies the manufactured attribution's product.

changed_reading.before: Inventing a lie about God is exceptionally unjust.
changed_reading.after: The wrongdoing is a manufactured reassignment of divine identity or authorization that displaces the truthful claim owed to God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The q-w-m sequence moves from the Book as upright, to youths who rise after heart-stabilization and declare sole lordship, to qawmuna as social body. The group becomes a contested structure of standing: embodied counter-standing tests whether communal standing is straight.

activation_trace.role: The literal uprightness and straightness image supplies a norm against which the later social body can be tested.
Binding the heart as firmness supplies the enabling stability for public dissent.
Rising with resolve turns the root from a quality into an embodied act of opposition.
Lordship as ownership and sovereignty supplies what the youths affirm before rejecting another invocation.
Deviation from truth names where invoking another deity would place their speech.
The social-group image receives the prior uprightness and rising images as a disputed communal standing.

structural_cues: 18:2, 18:14, and 18:15 repeat q-w-m as adjective, verb, and communal noun.
18:14 places heart-binding before standing and public speech; 18:15 immediately identifies the dissenters' own people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the root recurrence and sequence; I infer a movement from upright criterion to embodied counter-standing to judgment of communal standing. A live alternative is that the recurrence is rhetorical texture without this directional chain.

changed_reading.before: 'Our people' is a group descriptor for those holding a false belief.
changed_reading.after: 'Our people' names a contested normative standing: a stabilized minority rises within the social body and asks what actually makes that body stand straight.

context_deltas.mechanism: 18:4-5 supplies a local specimen of the focus charge: a theological relation is adopted, no disclosed knowledge supports it, speech attributes what is not, and the output is explicitly false. The focus generalizes that pipeline to the people's other gods and demands a warrant that could interrupt it.

activation_trace.role: Making or acquiring for oneself repeats adoption in the specific claim that God took a son.
Disclosure to a knower is explicitly absent, supplying the claim's source failure.
Saying or attributing what was not supplies unsupported attribution as a speech act.
Contrariety to truth explicitly classifies the unsupported speech as false.
Invented falsehood converts the prior speech sequence into the focus ayah's diagnosis.
Overpowering proof supplies the missing control that unsupported repetition cannot replace.

structural_cues: 18:4 and 18:15 repeat adoption language around claims involving God.
18:5 joins lack of knowledge, mouth-produced speech, and explicit falsehood before 18:15 names fabrication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated adoption and the no-knowledge-to-false-speech sequence; I infer that 18:4-5 is a prototype whose source chain 18:15 audits. The live alternative is that 18:4-5 remains a narrower sonship polemic rather than a general model of cultic claims.

changed_reading.before: The lie is an unsupported proposition about God.
changed_reading.after: The lie is the product of a traceable social-speech pipeline: adoption becomes attribution without disclosed knowledge, while clear authority is the missing source control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next command converts the focus diagnosis into separation from both the people and what they worship, followed by refuge. The later threat of domination, stoning, or forced return to their creed shows why communal adoption is not private opinion but an enforceable affiliation.

activation_trace.role: Removal into a separate side turns doctrinal refusal into a social boundary.
Submissive worship identifies the practice from which separation is required.
Joining a sheltering side supplies the spatial consequence of leaving the communal cult.
Ascendancy and domination supply the community's capacity to enforce its order.
Return after departure supplies coerced re-entry as the threatened reversal.
A followed creed names the normative system into which the youths could be forced back.
The social body now carries both kinship and the enforcement pressure revealed by the context.
Communal adoption becomes the norm from which exit and forced return are possible.

structural_cues: 18:16 follows the focus charge with a command to separate from the people and their worship and to seek the cave.
18:20 pairs communal discovery with threats of stoning or restoration to the community's creed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies separation, refuge, domination, and forced return; I infer that the focus's failed warrant marks the cult as a coercive boundary system. A live alternative is that danger, rather than the evidentiary diagnosis itself, is the primary cause of withdrawal.

changed_reading.before: The people's taking of gods is a collective doctrinal error.
changed_reading.after: It is also an enforceable creed: rejecting its warrant creates a spatial and social exit, while the group retains power to compel return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context supplies a positive control, report matched to reality, and two negative controls: visible appearance can yield a wrong classification, and speech can cast guesses into the unseen. A clear authority must therefore disclose reality rather than merely look evident or sound confident.

activation_trace.role: Stable correspondence with reality supplies the positive standard for the narrated report.
Supposition supplies the observer's mistaken classification from appearances.
Literal wakefulness supplies the apparent state assigned by the observer.
Literal sleep and stillness supply the reality that contradicts the apparent state.
Speaking by conjecture about the unseen supplies the second failure mode.
What is hidden from sight marks the domain into which unsupported claims are projected.
Decisive proof becomes the control that can overcome both perceptual and conjectural error.
Disclosure into clarity now means manifestation of actual state, not surface obviousness alone.

structural_cues: 18:18 explicitly opposes 'you suppose them awake' to 'while they are sleeping.'
18:22 labels numerical claims as casting into the unseen, then restricts disputation and inquiry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reality-matched report, false appearance, and unseen conjecture; I infer that these calibrate the focus's standard of clear authority. A live alternative is that the scenes regulate only cave perception and number speculation, not deity-claims generally.

changed_reading.before: A clear authority is an argument that appears obvious.
changed_reading.after: A clear authority is reality-matched disclosure able to correct misleading appearance and restrain confident projection into what is hidden.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later, a prevailing faction moves from proposing construction to 'taking' a place of prostration over the youths. The repeated adoption root back-activates the focus: public worship forms can be made, built, and secured by victorious power, so taking gods may include institutional production rather than inward assent alone.

activation_trace.role: Building by joining parts supplies the conversion of a contested account into a durable structure.
Overpowering force identifies which faction can materialize its worship decision.
Making something for oneself repeats the focus's adoption mechanism in an institutional setting.
A place of prostration supplies the built worship form produced by the prevailing group.
The same making-for-oneself image opens the backward analogy to the people's gods.
The worshipped-object image keeps the institutional analogy anchored in the focus's deity claim.

structural_cues: 18:21 first reports a proposal to build over the youths, then gives the prevailing faction's resolve to take a place of prostration over them.
18:15 and 18:21 repeat the same adoption verb in cultically charged constructions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies construction, victory, repeated adoption, and a worship site; I infer backward that power can manufacture public cultic arrangements. The live alternative is that the later worship site serves true worship and must not be morally equated with the false gods of 18:15.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the people participate in producing gods as public institutions: adoption, built form, and prevailing power can make a cult socially real.

context_deltas.mechanism: The window closes by repeating 'besides Him,' denying any governing patron there, and denying every partnership in His judgment. This activates the authority branch of sultan: the focus's gods can be read not only as cult objects but as claimed patrons or shares in governance that would require authorization.

activation_trace.role: Otherness or being besides repeats the focus's alternative-position construction.
Taking charge of an affair supplies the governing-patron role denied to every alternative.
Partnership supplies the share in judgment that the closing statement excludes.
Judgment between parties supplies the exclusive governing domain at issue.
Exhaustive negation closes the possibility of any partner in that domain.
The worshipped-object image remains the focus anchor while the context broadens its possible function.
Power and delegated authority turn the demanded sultan into a question of authorized governance.

structural_cues: 18:26 repeats the focus's 'besides Him' construction and then coordinates denial of a patron with denial of partnership in judgment.
The closing exclusivity statement lies inside the packet window and supplies a backward frame for the focus's authority demand.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exclusive patronage and judgment; I infer backward that deity language can include claimed governing or mediating authority. A live alternative is that 'gods' in the focus remains strictly cultic and the governance expansion is secondary.

changed_reading.before: The demanded proof concerns whether alternative objects deserve worship.
changed_reading.after: One coexisting reading asks whether any alternative patron has a divinely authorized share in governance; the window's close denies the domain such a partner.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses material-craft and deceptive-cloth branches rather than the ordinary falsehood senses. It remains valid as a cross-domain image anchored directly in ٱفْتَرَىٰ and كَذِبًا; downstream prose should mark it as exploratory imagery, not claim that these branches define the verse's words.

activation_trace.role: Cutting material for repair and sewing supplies the image of a claim fabricated to fit.
A decorated cloth that misreports its condition supplies a deceptive surface for the fitted claim.

changed_reading.before: A false statement is invented and assigned to God.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the deity-claim is a cut-and-fitted surface whose crafted appearance misrepresents its actual condition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps the earth's temporary adornment and stripping onto cultic adoption. It remains anchored in taking gods and demanding proof, with context branches supplying a test-and-removal analogy; downstream prose should present it as a provisional material model, not as an asserted referent of the gods.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةًۭ ... بِسُلْطَٰنٍۭ بَيِّنٍۢ

activation_trace.role: Making beauty visible supplies the attractive surface that can solicit misplaced adoption.
Testing that reveals actual condition turns surface attraction into an evidentiary trial.
Land stripped of vegetation supplies the removal test for what appeared valuable.
Making something for oneself anchors the analogy in the people's act of adoption.
Decisive proof becomes the criterion for what survives the stripping of attractive surface.

changed_reading.before: The people adopted false gods without evidence.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they installed an attractive test-surface as divine; the proof demand asks what remains of the claim when ornament is stripped to barrenness.

strongest_changes: The q-w-m recurrence recasts 'our people' as contested communal standing between an upright criterion and the youths' embodied counter-standing.
18:4-5 turns fabrication into a source-auditable pipeline from adoption through attribution without knowledge to explicit falsehood.
The cave's misleading appearance and the later casting of guesses into the unseen sharpen clear authority into reality-matched disclosure.
Separation, coerced return, and later institution-building expose communal cult as spatial, enforceable, and potentially produced by prevailing power.
18:26 broadens one live reading from worship objects to unauthorized patronage or partnership in judgment.
summary.what_was_special: Tight recurrences of q-w-m, adoption, and 'besides Him' activated social and institutional mechanisms alongside the obvious epistemic one. Material branches of fabrication, deceptive appearance, adornment, and stripping preserved two contained exploratory readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The q-w-m chain may be a meaningful mechanism or only rhetorical and morphological texture.
The 18:21 institution-making analogy is live but must not equate its worship site morally with the false gods of 18:15.
The patronage-and-judgment expansion from 18:26 may remain secondary to the focus's direct cultic sense.
The cut-cloth and provisional-adornment outliers are branch-anchored analogies, not lexical conclusions.
